385	local function getChunkFiles()
386	    local chunks = {}
387	    local ok, iter, dir = pcall(hs.fs.dir, CHUNK_DIR)

392	        end
393	    end
394	    -- Sort by the numeric index, not lexicographically: ffmpeg's %03d overflows past 999
395	    -- ("chunk_1000.wav" sorts before "chunk_999.wav" as a string), which would splice the
396	    -- tail of any recording longer than ~16m40s into the middle of the transcript.
397	    table.sort(chunks, function(a, b)
398	        local ia = tonumber(a:match("chunk_(%d+)%.wav$")) or 0
399	        local ib = tonumber(b:match("chunk_(%d+)%.wav$")) or 0
400	        if ia == ib then return a < b end
401	        return ia < ib
402	    end)
403	    return chunks
404	end

490	-- Transcribe a WAV file via the remote OpenAI-compatible API instead of local whisper-cli.
491	-- Returns the hs.task so callers can terminate it on timeout if needed.
492	-- callback(text, detectedLang, errMsg) — errMsg is set (and text empty) on failure.
493	local function transcribeViaAPI(wavPath, lang, timeoutSecs, callback)
494	    local args = {
495	        "-s", "-S", "-f", "-m", tostring(timeoutSecs or 30),
496	        "-F", "file=@" .. wavPath,
497	        "-F", "model=" .. API.MODEL_ID,
498	        "-F", "response_format=verbose_json",
499	        -- Server translates to English if 'language' is omitted entirely (even with
500	        -- task=transcribe) — always send it, "auto" included, to force transcription.
501	        "-F", "language=" .. (lang or "auto"),
502	    }
503	    table.insert(args, API.URL)
504	
505	    local task = hs.task.new(API.CURL_BIN, function(code, out, err)
506	        if code ~= 0 then
507	            local errMsg = curlErrorMessage(code, err)
508	            log("api: curl failed code=" .. tostring(code) .. " err=" .. tostring(err))
509	            callback("", nil, errMsg)
510	            return
511	        end
512	        local ok, decoded = pcall(hs.json.decode, out or "")
513	        if not ok or type(decoded) ~= "table" or not decoded.text then
514	            log("api: unexpected response: " .. tostring(out))
515	            callback("", nil, "unexpected server response")
516	            return
517	        end
518	        callback(decoded.text, normalizeApiLang(decoded.language), nil)
519	    end, args)
520	    task:start()
521	    return task
522	end

947	local function makeWaveformIcon(color, asTemplate)
948	    local w, h = 18, 18
949	    local c = hs.canvas.new({ x = 0, y = 0, w = w, h = h })
950	    -- Bar heights (symmetric waveform: short-medium-tall-medium-short)
951	    local bars = { 0.3, 0.55, 1.0, 0.55, 0.3 }
952	    local barW = 2

954	    local totalW = #bars * barW + (#bars - 1) * gap
955	    local startX = (w - totalW) / 2
956	    for i, scale in ipairs(bars) do
957	        local barH = math.floor(h * 0.75 * scale)
958	        local x = startX + (i - 1) * (barW + gap)
959	        local y = (h - barH) / 2
960	        c:appendElements({
961	            type = "rectangle",
962	            frame = { x = x, y = y, w = barW, h = barH },
963	            fillColor = color,
964	            roundedRectRadii = { xRadius = 1, yRadius = 1 },
965	            action = "fill",
966	        })
967	    end
968	    local img = c:imageFromCanvas()
969	    c:delete()
970	    img:template(asTemplate)
971	    return img

1109	local function updateProgressBar()
1110	    if not overlay then return end
1111	    local BAR_MAX = 386  -- px, matches bar_bg width in createOverlay
1112	    -- Freeze at the final duration once recording stops. Left live, this keeps climbing
1113	    -- during transcription and re-trips the auto-expand below on every segment, so
1114	    -- barMaxSecs outruns transcribedSecs and the blue bar never reaches 100%.
1115	    local elapsed = recordedSecs or (hs.timer.secondsSinceEpoch() - recordingStartTime)
1116	    -- Auto-expand: when recording reaches 90% of max, extend by another 3 min
1117	    if elapsed >= barMaxSecs * 0.9 then barMaxSecs = barMaxSecs + 180 end
1118	    local recFrac = math.min(elapsed / barMaxSecs, 1.0)
1119	    local txnFrac = math.min(transcribedSecs / barMaxSecs, 1.0)
1120	    overlay[EL.bar_rec].frame = { x = 17, y = 48, w = math.max(1, math.floor(recFrac * BAR_MAX)), h = 4 }
1121	    overlay[EL.bar_txn].frame = { x = 17, y = 48, w = math.max(1, math.floor(txnFrac * BAR_MAX)), h = 4 }
1122	end
1123

1132	    if not overlay then return end
1133	    recordingStartTime = hs.timer.secondsSinceEpoch()
1134	    recordedSecs = nil
1135	    transcribedSecs = 0
1136	    barMaxSecs = 180
1137	    pulseAlpha = 1.0
1138	    pulseFading = true
1139	
1140	    -- Show dot and timer
1141	    overlay[EL.dot].fillColor = { red = 0.85, green = 0.1, blue = 0.1, alpha = 1.0 }
1142	    overlay[EL.timer].textColor = { red = 0.75, green = 0.15, blue = 0.15, alpha = 1.0 }
1143	
1144	    -- Show progress bar track
1145	    overlay[EL.bar_bg].fillColor  = { red = 0.3, green = 0.3, blue = 0.3, alpha = 0.6 }
1146	    overlay[EL.bar_rec].fillColor = { red = 1.0, green = 0.35, blue = 0.15, alpha = 0.85 }
1147	    overlay[EL.bar_txn].fillColor = { red = 0.2, green = 0.75, blue = 1.0, alpha = 0.9 }
1148	    updateProgressBar()
1149	
1150	    -- Pulse the red dot
1151	    pulseTimer = hs.timer.doEvery(0.05, function()
1152	        if not overlay then return end
1153	        if pulseFading then
1154	            pulseAlpha = pulseAlpha - 0.03

1156	        else

1158	            if pulseAlpha >= 1.0 then pulseFading = true end
1159	        end
1160	        overlay[EL.dot].fillColor = { red = 0.85, green = 0.1, blue = 0.1, alpha = pulseAlpha }
1161	    end)
1162	
1163	    -- Update elapsed time and recording progress every second
1164	    clockTimer = hs.timer.doEvery(1, function()
1165	        if not overlay then return end
1166	        local elapsed = math.floor(hs.timer.secondsSinceEpoch() - recordingStartTime)
1167	        local min = math.floor(elapsed / 60)
1168	        local sec = elapsed % 60
1169	        overlay[EL.timer].text = string.format("%d:%02d", min, sec)

1171	    end)

1216	    if mode == "paste" then

1221	    elseif mode == "copy" then

1229	-- Finish insertion after all processing (post-process, refine, hooks)
1230	local function finishInsertion(text, detectedLang)
1231	    -- Build action context and run pre-insert hooks
1232	    local ctx = buildActionContext(normalizeText(text), detectedLang or getLang(), getOutputMode())
1233	    runPreInsertActions(ctx)
1234	
1235	    local finalText = normalizeText(ctx.text)
1236	    if finalText == "" then
1237	        log("final: empty text after actions")
1238	        hideOverlay()
1239	        return
1240	    end
1241	
1242	    if ctx.insert then
1243	        -- Track for undo
1244	        lastInsertedText = finalText
1245	        insertTextAtCursor(finalText, ctx.outputMode)
1246	        ctx.inserted = true
1247	
1248	        -- Press Enter after insertion if enter mode is on (not applicable to copy-only mode)
1249	        if getEnterMode() and ctx.outputMode ~= "copy" then
1250	            hs.timer.doAfter(0.15, function()
1251	                hs.eventtap.keyStroke({}, "return")
1252	            end)
1253	        end
1254	    else
1255	        log("final: insertion disabled by action hooks")
1256	    end
1257	
1258	    ctx.text = finalText
1259	    runPostInsertActions(ctx)
1260	
1261	    -- Track in recent dictations
1262	    table.insert(recentDictations, 1, {
1263	        text = ctx.originalText,
1264	        time = os.time(),
1265	        inserted = ctx.inserted,
1266	        app = capturedAppName or "?",
1267	    })
1268	    while #recentDictations > MAX_RECENT do
1269	        table.remove(recentDictations)
1270	    end

1272	
1273	    local display = finalText
1274	    if detectedLang then display = display .. " [" .. detectedLang:upper() .. "]" end

1281	local function insertTranscribedText(text, detectedLang)
1282	    if text == "" or isHallucination(text) then
1283	        hideOverlay()
1284	        return
1285	    end
1286	
1287	    -- Apply app-aware post-processing
1288	    text = postProcess(text, capturedAppBundleID)

1290

1305	-- Max seconds per whisper call — keeps each segment within whisper's sweet spot
1306	-- and prevents the model from losing the beginning of long recordings.
1307	local FINAL_SEGMENT_SECS = 55
1308	
1309	local function doFinalTranscription()
1310	    local chunks = getChunkFiles()
1311	
1312	    -- ДИАГНОСТИКА: логируем все чанки и состояние
1313	    log("final: START — total chunks=" .. #chunks)
1314	    if #chunks > 0 then
1315	        local first = chunks[1]:match("([^/]+)$") or chunks[1]
1316	        local last  = chunks[#chunks]:match("([^/]+)$") or chunks[#chunks]
1317	        log("final: first=" .. first .. "  last=" .. last .. "  duration≈" .. #chunks .. "s")
1318	    end
1319	
1320	    if #chunks < 2 then
1321	        log("final: not enough chunks, skipping")
1322	        hideProgressBar()
1323	        hideOverlay()
1324	        return
1325	    end
1326	
1327	    setOverlayText("Transcribing...")
1328	
1329	    local lang = getLang()
1330	    local preferred = getPreferredLangs()
1331	    local promptArgs = getPromptArgs()
1332	
1333	    -- Split 1-second chunks into groups of FINAL_SEGMENT_SECS
1334	    local segmentGroups = {}
1335	    local i = 1
1336	    while i <= #chunks do
1337	        local group = {}
1338	        for j = i, math.min(i + FINAL_SEGMENT_SECS - 1, #chunks) do
1339	            table.insert(group, chunks[j])
1340	        end
1341	        table.insert(segmentGroups, group)
1342	        i = i + FINAL_SEGMENT_SECS
1343	    end
1344	
1345	    local totalSegs = #segmentGroups
1346	    log("final: segments=" .. totalSegs .. " (FINAL_SEGMENT_SECS=" .. FINAL_SEGMENT_SECS .. ")")
1347	    for si, grp in ipairs(segmentGroups) do
1348	        local gfirst = grp[1]:match("([^/]+)$") or grp[1]
1349	        local glast  = grp[#grp]:match("([^/]+)$") or grp[#grp]
1350	        log("final: seg " .. si .. " → " .. #grp .. " chunks (" .. gfirst .. " … " .. glast .. ")")
1351	    end
1352	
1353	    local allTexts = {}
1354	    local detectedLangOverall = nil
1355	    local segIdx = 0
1356	    local apiErrorMsg = nil
1357	
1358	    local function finishAll()
1359	        log("final: finishAll — collected " .. #allTexts .. " text segment(s)")
1360	        local finalText = table.concat(allTexts, " "):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""):gsub("%s+", " ")
1361	        log("final combined (" .. totalSegs .. " seg(s)): '" .. finalText .. "'")
1362	        if finalText == "" then
1363	            hideProgressBar()

content.text:
Прочитал весь [init.lua](hammerspoon/init.lua) (1841 строк) + конфиг в `~/.local-whisper/` и установленные хуки. Вот полный двухуровневый список.

Легенда: ✅ работает и используется · ⚠️ работает, но кандидат на удаление · ❌ мёртвый код (не вызывается)

## 1. Запись аудио
- ✅ Триггер — удержание правого Cmd (`eventtap` на `flagsChanged` + поллинг отпускания раз в 0.1 с), [init.lua:1756](hammerspoon/init.lua#L1756)
- ✅ Warmup микрофона — до 10 попыток по 1 с, тик Tink перед каждой, при провале «Микрофон недоступен» + Basso, [init.lua:1620](hammerspoon/init.lua#L1620)
- ✅ Чанкованная запись — ffmpeg/avfoundation, mono 16 kHz, сегменты по 1 с в `chunk_%03d.wav`
- ✅ Звуковая обратная связь — Pop (первый чанк на диске), Tink (стоп), Glass (вставка), Basso (ошибка)
- ✅ Emergency stop — сброс всего состояния + `killall whisper-cli`, [init.lua:1190](hammerspoon/init.lua#L1190)
- ✅ Восстановление после сна системы — `caffeinate.watcher`, дожимает потерянную финализацию, [init.lua:1797](hammerspoon/init.lua#L1797)
- ✅ Самолечение eventtap — реэнейбл каждые 5 с (secure input)
- ❌ **Авто-стоп по тишине** — `checkSilence()` [init.lua:1511](hammerspoon/init.lua#L1511) определён, но не вызывается **ни разу**; `silenceTimer` только останавливается, никогда не создаётся. Вместе с ним мертвы `AUTO_STOP_SILENCE_SECONDS`, `AUTO_STOP_THRESHOLD_DB`, `silentChunkCount`, `lastCheckedChunk` (~45 строк)
- ⚠️ Настройка `TRIGGER_KEY` / `AUDIO_DEVICE` — три варианта клавиши и автопочинка префикса `:`, но правится только в исходнике

## 2. Транскрипция
- ✅ Локальный whisper-cli выбранной моделью (сейчас `large-v3-turbo-q5_0`)
- ⚠️ **Удалённое API** — OpenAI-совместимый эндпоинт с захардкоженным `192.168.0.13:13305` ([init.lua:31](hammerspoon/init.lua#L31)), плюс `transcribeViaAPI`, `curlErrorMessage` и таблица `normalizeApiLang` на ~100 языков ([init.lua:462](hammerspoon/init.lua#L462), 27 строк). Живёт только ради этого режима — если API не используешь, это ~110 строк
- ✅ Нарезка на сегменты по 55 с + склейка через ffmpeg concat
- ✅ Числовая сортировка чанков (защита от переполнения `%03d` после 999)
- ✅ Языки en / ru / uk / auto, авто-детект на каждый сегмент (code-switching)
- ✅ Фильтр галлюцинаций — список из 18 фраз + всё в скобках/квадратных скобках
- ⚠️ Custom vocabulary prompt (`~/.local-whisper/prompt`) — файл пуст, UI для него нет вообще
- ❌ **Preferred languages** — читается, пишется дефолт `en,pt` при старте, показывается в меню отключённым пунктом, но на транскрипцию **не влияет**: `local preferred` в [init.lua:1330](hammerspoon/init.lua#L1330) нигде не используется (логика ретрая удалена, см. комментарий на [init.lua:1474](hammerspoon/init.lua#L1474))
- ❌ Партиалы на tiny-модели — описаны в AGENTS.md, в коде отсутствуют (документация врёт)

## 3. Постобработка текста
- ✅ Удаление филлеров — um / uh / hmm / «like,»
- ✅ Авто-капитализация с исключением для терминалов и IDE (список из 9 bundle ID)
- ✅ Нормализация пробелов
- ✅ LLM-refine через Ollama — свой промпт и модель, порог 50 символов, срезание преамбул («Here is the cleaned text:» и т.п.), [init.lua:326](hammerspoon/init.lua#L326)
- ✅ Кешированный пробинг Ollama (TTL 30 с, чтобы не вешать eventtap)
- ⚠️ Refine выключен в конфиге (`refine=off`) — если не планируешь включать, это ~90 строк + пункт меню + eval-набор `tests/test_refine.sh`

## 4. Вставка текста
- ✅ Три режима вывода: paste (Cmd+V), type (посимвольно), copy (только буфер)
- ✅ Enter после вставки (переключатель, не действует в режиме copy)
- ❌ **Undo** — `lastInsertedText` присваивается в [init.lua:1244](hammerspoon/init.lua#L1244) и **больше нигде не читается**; хоткея на откат нет (во всём файле нет ни одного `hs.hotkey`)

## 5. Action hooks / голосовые команды
- ✅ Автозагрузка `~/.hammerspoon/local_whisper_actions.lua` с автоперезагрузкой по mtime
- ✅ Три точки входа: `beforeInsert`, список `actions` (с `pattern`/`when`), `afterInsert`
- ✅ API контекста: `setText`, `disableInsert`/`enableInsert`, `launchApp`, `appendToFile`, `runShell`, `keystroke`, `notify`, `log`
- ✅ Поля контекста: text/textLower/originalText, lang, outputMode, appName/appBundleID, timestamp/isoTime, handled
- ✅ Пропуск LLM-refine для фраз с «voice command»
- ✅ Установленные у тебя команды: cancel, note, remind, open app, select all, copy, paste, undo
- ⚠️ `ctx:runShell` — выполняет произвольный shell с текстом диктовки на stdin; единственное место, где голос граничит с исполнением кода

## 6. Оверлей
- ✅ Панель под меню-баром поверх всех спейсов и фуллскрина
- ✅ Статусный текст: `...`, Refining…, Transcribing n/m, финальный текст + код языка
- ✅ Пульсирующая красная точка + таймер записи
- ✅ Двухцветный прогресс-бар: красный = записано, синий = распознано, авто-расширение шкалы на +3 мин
- ✅ Пин по клику на фон (оверлей остаётся висеть)
- ✅ Кнопка ✕ — прерывает запись или закрывает панель

## 7. Меню-бар
- ✅ Иконка-волна, красная во время записи, template-режим в покое
- ✅ Переключатели по клику: Language, Model (циклом по `~/whisper.cpp/models` + API), Output, Enter, LLM Refine
- ✅ Recent Dictations — последние 10, клик вставляет через буфер
- ✅ Reload Actions, Emergency Stop
- ❌ Пункт «Preferred: …» — disabled, чисто декоративный (см. п.2)
- ⚠️ «Settings…» — открывает запиненный оверлей с текстом «use the menu bar to change settings», то есть ничего не настраивает, [init.lua:1039](hammerspoon/init.lua#L1039)

## 8. Состояние и конфиг
- ✅ `~/.local-whisper/`: lang, model, output, enter, refine, refine_model, refine_prompt, prompt, preferred_langs, recent.json
- ✅ Лог в `$TMPDIR/whisper-dictate/whisper-dictate.log`
- ✅ `hs.ipc` — управление через `hs -c` (нужно тестам и деплою)
- ✅ Уведомления hs.notify при старте / стопе / перезагрузке хуков
- ❌ Глобал `_whisper` — поле `recording` инициализируется `false` и никогда не обновляется, [init.lua:1754](hammerspoon/init.lua#L1754)
- ❌ Каталог `~/.local-whisper/recovery/` — сирота от удалённого meeting mode, в коде не упоминается
- ❌ `RECOVERED_18-54_dictation.txt` в корне репо — мусор

## 9. Вне рантайма (репозиторий)
- ✅ `install.sh`, `setup.sh`, `uninstall.sh`
- ✅ `tests/test_init.sh` + `test_init.lua` (12 проверок), `tests/test_refine.sh`
- ⚠️ `tools/transcribe.sh` — самостоятельный батч-CLI для файлов/папок, к диктовке отношения не имеет (11 KB)
- ⚠️ `.specstory/` — сотни JSON-файлов истории в git (сейчас в `git status` их десятки незакоммиченных)

---

**Чистые кандидаты на удаление без потери функциональности** (всё подтверждено грепом, не догадки): авто-стоп по тишине, undo-переменная, preferred langs, `_whisper` глобал, каталог `recovery/`, `RECOVERED_*.txt`. Это ~80 строк из init.lua и минус 4-5 top-level локалов от текущих 144/200.

**Решать тебе** (работает, но, возможно, не нужно): режим удалённого API (~110 строк), LLM-refine (~90 строк + eval-набор), пункт «Settings…», `tools/transcribe.sh`.

Скажи, что из второй группы выкидываем — заведу bd-issue и вычищу всё за один проход с прогоном `tests/test_init.sh`.

3	#
4	# Runs tests/test_init.lua through the Hammerspoon `hs` CLI, since this stack has
5	# no standalone Lua interpreter. Requires Hammerspoon to be running.
6	#
7	# Usage:
8	#   ./tests/test_init.sh                 # test the repo's init.lua
9	#   ./tests/test_init.sh path/to/init.lua  # test a specific file

14	YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
15	BOLD='\033[1m'

17	
18	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
19	REPO_DIR="$(dirname "$SCRIPT_DIR")"
20	
21	TARGET="${1:-$REPO_DIR/hammerspoon/init.lua}"
22	# hs runs as the Hammerspoon process, so paths must be absolute.
23	TARGET="$(cd "$(dirname "$TARGET")" && pwd)/$(basename "$TARGET")"
24	
25	HS_BIN="$(command -v hs || echo /Applications/Hammerspoon.app/Contents/Frameworks/hs/hs)"
26	if [[ ! -x "$HS_BIN" ]]; then
27	    echo -e "${RED}Error: the 'hs' CLI was not found.${NC}"
28	    echo "Enable it from the Hammerspoon console: hs.ipc.cliInstall()"
29	    exit 1

31

33	    echo -e "${RED}Error: Hammerspoon is not running.${NC}"
34	    echo "These tests execute Lua through Hammerspoon's runtime. Start Hammerspoon and retry."
35	    exit 1
36	fi
37	
38	OUT="$(mktemp -t lw_test_init)"

41	echo -e "${BOLD}local-whisper init.lua test suite${NC}"

43	echo ""
44	
45	# hs evaluates in the running Hammerspoon process and does not inherit this shell's
46	# environment, so pass the paths as globals rather than env vars.

48

50	    echo -e "${RED}Error: the test suite produced no output.${NC}"
51	    echo "Check that $SCRIPT_DIR/test_init.lua loads cleanly."
52	    exit 1
53	fi
54

56	FAIL=0
57	while IFS=$'\t' read -r status name detail; do

60	        PASS=$((PASS + 1))
61	        echo -e "  ${GREEN}PASS${NC}  $name"
62	    else
63	        FAIL=$((FAIL + 1))
64	        echo -e "  ${RED}FAIL${NC}  $name"
65	        [[ -n "$detail" ]] && echo -e "        ${YELLOW}$detail${NC}"
66	    fi
67	done < "$OUT"
68	
69	TOTAL=$((PASS + FAIL))
70	echo ""
71	if [[ $FAIL -eq 0 ]]; then
72	    echo -e "${GREEN}${BOLD}All $TOTAL checks passed.${NC}"
73	    exit 0
74	else
75	    echo -e "${RED}${BOLD}$FAIL of $TOTAL checks failed.${NC}"
76	    exit 1
77	fi

1	-- test_init.lua — structural and behavioral tests for hammerspoon/init.lua
2	--
3	-- Run via tests/test_init.sh (which drives it through the Hammerspoon `hs` CLI,
4	-- since there is no standalone Lua interpreter in this stack).
5	--
6	-- These tests guard the bug classes that have actually bitten this file:
7	--   * a top-level local referenced by an earlier-defined function, which silently
8	--     compiles to a nil global instead of capturing the local
9	--   * the Lua 200-local-per-function ceiling
10	--   * unguarded hs.sound.getByFile(...):play(), which throws and aborts its callback
11	--   * chunk filenames sorted as strings, which reorders audio past chunk 999
12	--
13	-- Config (set as globals by the runner; `hs` does not inherit the caller's environment):
14	--   LW_TARGET  path to the init.lua under test (default: repo copy)
15	--   LW_OUT     path to write results to (default: /tmp/lw_test_init.txt)
16	
17	local HOME   = os.getenv("HOME")
18	local TARGET = _G.LW_TARGET or (HOME .. "/Documents/GitHub/local-whisper/hammerspoon/init.lua")
19	local OUT    = _G.LW_OUT or "/tmp/lw_test_init.txt"
20	
21	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
22	-- Harness
23	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
24	
25	local results = {}
26	
27	local function record(name, passed, detail)
28	    results[#results + 1] = {
29	        name   = name,
30	        passed = passed and true or false,
31	        detail = detail or "",
32	    }
33	end
34	
35	local function check(name, passed, detail)
36	    record(name, passed, passed and "" or (detail or ""))
37	end
38	
39	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
40	-- Source loading + lexical helpers
41	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
42	
43	local function readSource(path)
44	    local f = io.open(path, "r")
45	    if not f then return nil end
46	    local src = f:read("*a")
47	    f:close()
48	    return src
49	end
50	
51	local src = readSource(TARGET)
52	if not src then
53	    record("source readable", false, "cannot open " .. TARGET)
54	    local f = io.open(OUT, "w")
55	    f:write("FAIL\tsource readable\tcannot open " .. TARGET .. "\n")
56	    f:close()
57	    return
58	end
59	
60	local lines = {}
61	for line in (src .. "\n"):gmatch("([^\n]*)\n") do
62	    lines[#lines + 1] = line
63	end
64	
65	-- Blank out string literals and comments so scans don't match inside them.
66	local function strip(line)
67	    line = line:gsub('"[^"]*"', '""')
68	    line = line:gsub("'[^']*'", "''")
69	    line = line:gsub("%-%-.*$", "")
70	    return line
71	end
72	
73	local stripped = {}
74	for i, l in ipairs(lines) do stripped[i] = strip(l) end
75	
76	-- Word-boundary match for an identifier.
77	local function usesName(line, name)
78	    return line:find("%f[%w_]" .. name .. "%f[^%w_]") ~= nil
79	end
80	
81	-- Blank out identifier occurrences that are not variable *reads*, so the
82	-- use-before-declaration scan doesn't fire on them:
83	--   * field access / method call  -- obj.name, obj:name
84	--   * assignment targets and table-constructor keys -- name = ..., { name = ... }
85	-- A read of `name` on the right-hand side survives, which is what the scan wants.
86	local function readsOnly(s)
87	    s = s:gsub("%.%s*[%w_]+", " ")
88	    s = s:gsub(":%s*[%w_]+", " ")
89	    s = s:gsub("[%w_]+%s*=[^=]", " ")
90	    return s
91	end

93	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
94	-- Sandbox helpers (behavioral tests)
95	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
96	-- Functions are lifted out of the source under test and executed against stubbed
97	-- globals, so the tests exercise the real implementation rather than a copy that
98	-- drifts. Every name the lifted function closes over in init.lua resolves to the
99	-- sandbox _ENV here, which is what makes the stubs and the after-the-fact state
100	-- assertions work.
101	
102	local function baseEnv()
103	    return {
104	        math = math, string = string, table = table, os = os,
105	        tostring = tostring, tonumber = tonumber, type = type,
106	        ipairs = ipairs, pairs = pairs, select = select,
107	    }
108	end
109	
110	local function loadIn(chunk, env, name)
111	    return load(chunk, name or "sandbox", "t", env)
112	end
113	
114	-- Source text of a top-level `local function NAME(...) ... end`, located by its
115	-- declaration and terminated by the matching column-0 `end`.
116	local function extractFunction(name)
117	    local startLine
118	    for i, s in ipairs(stripped) do
119	        if s:match("^local%s+function%s+" .. name .. "%s*%(") then startLine = i break end
120	    end
121	    if not startLine then return nil end
122	    for i = startLine + 1, #lines do
123	        if stripped[i]:match("^end%s*$") then
124	            return table.concat({ table.unpack(lines, startLine, i) }, "\n")
125	        end
126	    end
127	    return nil
128	end
129	
130	-- Load a lifted `local function` and return it, bound to `env`.
131	local function liftFunction(name, env)
132	    local fnSrc = extractFunction(name)
133	    if not fnSrc then return nil, "could not locate local function " .. name .. "()" end
134	    local factory, err = loadIn(fnSrc .. "\nreturn " .. name, env, name)
135	    if not factory then return nil, tostring(err) end
136	    return factory()
137	end

158	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
159	-- 3. No top-level local referenced before it is declared
160	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
161	-- A `local` is only in scope after its declaration. A function defined earlier that
162	-- references the name does NOT capture it -- the reference compiles to a global read
163	-- that is nil at runtime, with no load-time error. This produced three live bugs in
164	-- the overlay code (X button, unpin, menu-bar pinning).
165	
166	-- Collect top-level declarations: name -> first declaring line.
167	local decls = {}
168	for i, s in ipairs(stripped) do
169	    local fname = s:match("^local%s+function%s+([%w_]+)")
170	    if fname then
171	        decls[fname] = decls[fname] or i
172	    else
173	        local names = s:match("^local%s+([%w_%s,]-)%s*=") or s:match("^local%s+([%w_%s,]+)%s*$")
174	        if names then
175	            for n in names:gmatch("[%w_]+") do
176	                if n ~= "function" then decls[n] = decls[n] or i end
177	            end
178	        end
179	    end
180	end

182	-- A name is "shadowed" before line `upto` if some earlier line binds it as a local,
183	-- a function parameter, or a loop variable -- in which case an earlier textual use
184	-- refers to that binding, not to the top-level one, and is not a bug.
185	local function shadowedBefore(name, upto)
186	    for i = 1, upto - 1 do
187	        local s = stripped[i]
188	        if s:match("%f[%w_]local%f[^%w_][^=]*%f[%w_]" .. name .. "%f[^%w_]") then return true end
189	        if s:match("%f[%w_]for%f[^%w_][^=]*%f[%w_]" .. name .. "%f[^%w_]") then return true end
190	        local params = s:match("function%s*(%b())")
191	        if params and usesName(params, name) then return true end
192	    end
193	    return false
194	end
195	
196	local violations = {}
197	for name, declLine in pairs(decls) do
198	    for i = 1, declLine - 1 do
199	        if usesName(readsOnly(stripped[i]), name) and not shadowedBefore(name, i + 1) then
200	            violations[#violations + 1] = string.format("%s used at L%d, declared at L%d", name, i, declLine)
201	            break
202	        end
203	    end
204	end
205	table.sort(violations)
206	check("scope: no top-level local used before its declaration",
207	      #violations == 0,
208	      table.concat(violations, "; "))

276	-- 7. Chunk ordering (behavioral -- exercises the real comparator)
277	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
278	-- The comparator is extracted from the source under test rather than reimplemented,
279	-- so this test tracks the real implementation instead of a copy that can drift.
280	
281	local cmpSrc = src:match("table%.sort%(chunks,%s*(function%s*%(a,%s*b%).-end)%)")
282	if not cmpSrc then
283	    check("sort: comparator is extractable from source", false,
284	          "could not locate table.sort(chunks, function(a, b) ... end)")
285	else
286	    check("sort: comparator is extractable from source", true)
287	    local factory, err = load("return " .. cmpSrc)
288	    if not factory then
289	        check("sort: comparator compiles", false, tostring(err))
290	    else
291	        check("sort: comparator compiles", true)
292	        local cmp = factory()
293	
294	        -- ffmpeg writes chunk_%03d.wav, which overflows past 999. Build an
295	        -- out-of-order list spanning the overflow boundary.
296	        local indices = { 1200, 3, 1000, 999, 0, 100, 1001, 99, 1 }
297	        local files = {}
298	        for _, n in ipairs(indices) do
299	            files[#files + 1] = string.format("/tmp/chunks/chunk_%03d.wav", n)
300	        end
301	        table.sort(files, cmp)
302	
303	        local got = {}
304	        for _, f in ipairs(files) do got[#got + 1] = tonumber(f:match("chunk_(%d+)%.wav$")) end
305	
306	        local expect = { 0, 1, 3, 99, 100, 999, 1000, 1001, 1200 }
307	        local same = #got == #expect
308	        if same then
309	            for i = 1, #expect do
310	                if got[i] ~= expect[i] then same = false break end
311	            end
312	        end
313	        check("sort: chunks order numerically across the 999 boundary", same,
314	              "got " .. table.concat(got, ",") .. " want " .. table.concat(expect, ","))
315	
316	        -- Guard the specific regression: 999 must precede 1000, which plain
317	        -- lexicographic sorting gets wrong ("chunk_1000" < "chunk_999").
318	        local pos = {}
319	        for i, n in ipairs(got) do pos[n] = i end
320	        check("sort: chunk 999 precedes chunk 1000 (lexicographic would not)",
321	              pos[999] and pos[1000] and pos[999] < pos[1000],
322	              "999 at index " .. tostring(pos[999]) .. ", 1000 at index " .. tostring(pos[1000]))
323	    end
324	end

402	    -- Click the overlay and return the resulting stub state. Deferred work is captured
403	    -- rather than run, so a test can assert on both sides of the hs.timer.doAfter.
404	    local function click(opts)
405	        local env    = baseEnv()
406	        local calls  = { hide = 0, delete = 0, emergency = 0, hideOverlay = 0 }
407	        local defer  = {}
408	        local canvas = {
409	            [1]    = { fillColor = {} },
410	            hide   = function() calls.hide = calls.hide + 1 end,
411	            delete = function() calls.delete = calls.delete + 1 end,

418	        env.hideOverlay   = function() calls.hideOverlay = calls.hideOverlay + 1 end
419	        env.hs = { timer = { doAfter = function(d, fn) defer[#defer + 1] = { delay = d, fn = fn } end } }

564	-- 13. Progress bar reaches 100% (behavioral)
565	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
566	-- Left on the live clock, `elapsed` keeps climbing during transcription and re-trips
567	-- the 90% auto-expand on every finished segment, so barMaxSecs outruns transcribedSecs
568	-- and the blue bar never catches the red one. stopRecordingIndicator() freezes the
569	-- duration into recordedSecs; updateProgressBar() must honour it.
570	
571	local elSrc = src:match("local%s+EL%s*=%s*(%b{})")
572	local EL = elSrc and loadIn("return " .. elSrc, baseEnv(), "EL")

575	      "could not read `local EL = { ... }` from source")
576	
577	if type(EL) == "table" then
578	    -- Drive updateProgressBar() over a scripted timeline of (clock, transcribedSecs).
579	    local function runBar(steps, recordedSecs)
580	        local env  = baseEnv()
581	        local now  = 0
582	        env.EL     = EL
583	        env.overlay = { [EL.bar_rec] = {}, [EL.bar_txn] = {} }
584	        env.recordingStartTime = 0
585	        env.recordedSecs       = recordedSecs
586	        env.transcribedSecs    = 0
587	        env.barMaxSecs         = 180
588	        env.hs = { timer = { secondsSinceEpoch = function() return now end } }
589	
590	        local fn, err = liftFunction("updateProgressBar", env)
591	        if not fn then return nil, err end

603	            env = env,

607	    -- 100s of audio, then transcription finishes while the wall clock runs on to 240s
608	    -- (past 0.9 * 180 = 162s, which is what used to re-trip the auto-expand).
609	    local bar, barErr = runBar({

613	        { 170, 66 },
614	        { 240, 100 },            -- all 100s transcribed
615	    })

620	              bar.txn == bar.rec,

644	    local startBody = extractFunction("startRecordingIndicator")

653	    -- BAR_MAX in updateProgressBar and the bar_bg track width in createOverlay are
654	    -- separate literals; drifting apart would misreport progress at the right edge.
655	    local barMax  = src:match("local%s+BAR_MAX%s*=%s*(%d+)")
656	    local trackW  = src:match('id%s*=%s*"bar_bg".-w%s*=%s*(%d+)')

664	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

2	--
3	-- Run via tests/test_init.sh (which drives it through the Hammerspoon `hs` CLI,
4	-- since there is no standalone Lua interpreter in this stack).
5	--
6	-- These tests guard the bug classes that have actually bitten this file:
7	--   * a top-level local referenced by an earlier-defined function, which silently
8	--     compiles to a nil global instead of capturing the local
9	--   * the Lua 200-local-per-function ceiling
10	--   * unguarded hs.sound.getByFile(...):play(), which throws and aborts its callback
11	--   * chunk filenames sorted as strings, which reorders audio past chunk 999
12	--
13	-- Config (set as globals by the runner; `hs` does not inherit the caller's environment):
14	--   LW_TARGET  path to the init.lua under test (default: repo copy)
15	--   LW_OUT     path to write results to (default: /tmp/lw_test_init.txt)
16	
17	local HOME   = os.getenv("HOME")
18	local TARGET = _G.LW_TARGET or (HOME .. "/Documents/GitHub/local-whisper/hammerspoon/init.lua")
19	local OUT    = _G.LW_OUT or "/tmp/lw_test_init.txt"

21	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
22	-- Harness
23	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
24	
25	local results = {}
26	
27	local function record(name, passed, detail)
28	    results[#results + 1] = {
29	        name   = name,
30	        passed = passed and true or false,
31	        detail = detail or "",
32	    }
33	end
34	
35	local function check(name, passed, detail)
36	    record(name, passed, passed and "" or (detail or ""))
37	end
38	
39	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
40	-- Source loading + lexical helpers
41	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
42	
43	local function readSource(path)
44	    local f = io.open(path, "r")
45	    if not f then return nil end
46	    local src = f:read("*a")
47	    f:close()
48	    return src
49	end
50	
51	local src = readSource(TARGET)
52	if not src then
53	    record("source readable", false, "cannot open " .. TARGET)
54	    local f = io.open(OUT, "w")
55	    f:write("FAIL\tsource readable\tcannot open " .. TARGET .. "\n")
56	    f:close()
57	    return
58	end
59	
60	local lines = {}
61	for line in (src .. "\n"):gmatch("([^\n]*)\n") do
62	    lines[#lines + 1] = line
63	end
64	
65	-- Blank out string literals and comments so scans don't match inside them.
66	local function strip(line)
67	    line = line:gsub('"[^"]*"', '""')
68	    line = line:gsub("'[^']*'", "''")
69	    line = line:gsub("%-%-.*$", "")
70	    return line
71	end
72	
73	local stripped = {}
74	for i, l in ipairs(lines) do stripped[i] = strip(l) end
75	
76	-- Word-boundary match for an identifier.
77	local function usesName(line, name)
78	    return line:find("%f[%w_]" .. name .. "%f[^%w_]") ~= nil
79	end
80	
81	-- Blank out identifier occurrences that are not variable *reads*, so the
82	-- use-before-declaration scan doesn't fire on them:
83	--   * field access / method call  -- obj.name, obj:name
84	--   * assignment targets and table-constructor keys -- name = ..., { name = ... }
85	-- A read of `name` on the right-hand side survives, which is what the scan wants.
86	local function readsOnly(s)
87	    s = s:gsub("%.%s*[%w_]+", " ")
88	    s = s:gsub(":%s*[%w_]+", " ")
89	    s = s:gsub("[%w_]+%s*=[^=]", " ")
90	    return s
91	end
92	
93	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
94	-- Sandbox helpers (behavioral tests)
95	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
96	-- Functions are lifted out of the source under test and executed against stubbed
97	-- globals, so the tests exercise the real implementation rather than a copy that
98	-- drifts. Every name the lifted function closes over in init.lua resolves to the
99	-- sandbox _ENV here, which is what makes the stubs and the after-the-fact state
100	-- assertions work.
101	
102	local function baseEnv()
103	    return {
104	        math = math, string = string, table = table, os = os,
105	        tostring = tostring, tonumber = tonumber, type = type,
106	        ipairs = ipairs, pairs = pairs, select = select,
107	    }
108	end
109	
110	local function loadIn(chunk, env, name)
111	    return load(chunk, name or "sandbox", "t", env)
112	end
113	
114	-- Source text of a top-level `local function NAME(...) ... end`, located by its
115	-- declaration and terminated by the matching column-0 `end`.
116	local function extractFunction(name)
117	    local startLine
118	    for i, s in ipairs(stripped) do
119	        if s:match("^local%s+function%s+" .. name .. "%s*%(") then startLine = i break end
120	    end
121	    if not startLine then return nil end
122	    for i = startLine + 1, #lines do
123	        if stripped[i]:match("^end%s*$") then
124	            return table.concat({ table.unpack(lines, startLine, i) }, "\n")
125	        end
126	    end
127	    return nil
128	end
129	
130	-- Load a lifted `local function` and return it, bound to `env`.
131	local function liftFunction(name, env)
132	    local fnSrc = extractFunction(name)
133	    if not fnSrc then return nil, "could not locate local function " .. name .. "()" end
134	    local factory, err = loadIn(fnSrc .. "\nreturn " .. name, env, name)
135	    if not factory then return nil, tostring(err) end
136	    return factory()
137	end

139	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
140	-- 1. Syntax
141	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
142	
143	local chunk, loadErr = loadfile(TARGET)

146	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
147	-- 2. Lua 200-local-per-function ceiling (AGENTS.md hard limit)
148	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
149	
150	local topLevelLocals = 0
151	for _, s in ipairs(stripped) do
152	    if s:match("^local%s") then topLevelLocals = topLevelLocals + 1 end
153	end
154	check("locals: top-level count within Lua's 200 ceiling",
155	      topLevelLocals <= 200,
156	      "found " .. topLevelLocals .. " top-level locals (limit 200)")
157	
158	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
159	-- 3. No top-level local referenced before it is declared
160	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
161	-- A `local` is only in scope after its declaration. A function defined earlier that
162	-- references the name does NOT capture it -- the reference compiles to a global read
163	-- that is nil at runtime, with no load-time error. This produced three live bugs in
164	-- the overlay code (X button, unpin, menu-bar pinning).
165	
166	-- Collect top-level declarations: name -> first declaring line.
167	local decls = {}
168	for i, s in ipairs(stripped) do
169	    local fname = s:match("^local%s+function%s+([%w_]+)")
170	    if fname then
171	        decls[fname] = decls[fname] or i
172	    else
173	        local names = s:match("^local%s+([%w_%s,]-)%s*=") or s:match("^local%s+([%w_%s,]+)%s*$")
174	        if names then
175	            for n in names:gmatch("[%w_]+") do
176	                if n ~= "function" then decls[n] = decls[n] or i end
177	            end
178	        end

180	end

182	-- A name is "shadowed" before line `upto` if some earlier line binds it as a local,
183	-- a function parameter, or a loop variable -- in which case an earlier textual use
184	-- refers to that binding, not to the top-level one, and is not a bug.
185	local function shadowedBefore(name, upto)
186	    for i = 1, upto - 1 do
187	        local s = stripped[i]
188	        if s:match("%f[%w_]local%f[^%w_][^=]*%f[%w_]" .. name .. "%f[^%w_]") then return true end
189	        if s:match("%f[%w_]for%f[^%w_][^=]*%f[%w_]" .. name .. "%f[^%w_]") then return true end
190	        local params = s:match("function%s*(%b())")
191	        if params and usesName(params, name) then return true end
192	    end
193	    return false
194	end

196	local violations = {}
197	for name, declLine in pairs(decls) do
198	    for i = 1, declLine - 1 do

388	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
389	-- 11. Overlay click behavior (behavioral -- runs the real mouse callback)

391	-- Two live bugs live here: clicking X mid-recording used to hide the overlay while
392	-- ffmpeg kept running, and deleting the canvas from inside its own mouse callback is

401	
402	    -- Click the overlay and return the resulting stub state. Deferred work is captured
403	    -- rather than run, so a test can assert on both sides of the hs.timer.doAfter.
404	    local function click(opts)
405	        local env    = baseEnv()
406	        local calls  = { hide = 0, delete = 0, emergency = 0, hideOverlay = 0 }
407	        local defer  = {}
408	        local canvas = {
409	            [1]    = { fillColor = {} },
410	            hide   = function() calls.hide = calls.hide + 1 end,
411	            delete = function() calls.delete = calls.delete + 1 end,
412	        }
413	        env.log           = function() end
414	        env.isRecording   = opts.recording and true or false
415	        env.overlayPinned = opts.pinned and true or false
416	        env.overlay       = canvas
417	        env.emergencyStop = function() calls.emergency = calls.emergency + 1 end
418	        env.hideOverlay   = function() calls.hideOverlay = calls.hideOverlay + 1 end
419	        env.hs = { timer = { doAfter = function(d, fn) defer[#defer + 1] = { delay = d, fn = fn } end } }

422	        if not factory then return nil, tostring(err) end
423	        -- A raw error here would abort the whole suite, so report it as a failure instead.
424	        local ok, runErr = pcall(factory(), canvas, opts.event, opts.id, 0, 0)
425	        if not ok then return nil, "callback errored: " .. tostring(runErr) end
426	        return { env = env, calls = calls, defer = defer, canvas = canvas }
427	    end

429	    local probe, probeErr = click({ event = "mouseDown", id = "close", recording = true })
430	    check("overlay: mouse callback compiles", probe ~= nil, tostring(probeErr))

432	    if probe then

436	        check("overlay: X defers the canvas delete (deleting inside the callback is ignored)",
437	              #probe.defer == 1 and probe.calls.delete == 0,
438	              #probe.defer .. " deferred call(s), delete called " .. probe.calls.delete .. " times synchronously")
439	
440	        if #probe.defer == 1 then

444	                  "emergencyStop() called " .. probe.calls.emergency .. " times")
445	            check("overlay: X during recording leaves teardown to emergencyStop",
446	                  probe.calls.delete == 0,
447	                  "overlay:delete() called directly instead of via emergencyStop()")

451	        end
452	
453	        -- X while idle: no recording to stop, so the callback owns the teardown.
454	        local idle = click({ event = "mouseDown", id = "close", recording = false, pinned = true })
455	        if idle and #idle.defer == 1 then
456	            idle.defer[1].fn()
457	            check("overlay: X while idle deletes the overlay and clears the handle",
458	                  idle.calls.delete == 1 and idle.env.overlay == nil,
459	                  "delete called " .. idle.calls.delete .. " times, overlay = " .. tostring(idle.env.overlay))
460	            check("overlay: X while idle does not call emergencyStop",
461	                  idle.calls.emergency == 0,
462	                  "emergencyStop() called " .. idle.calls.emergency .. " times")
463	        else
464	            check("overlay: X while idle deletes the overlay and clears the handle", false,
465	                  "expected exactly one deferred call, got " .. tostring(idle and #idle.defer))
466	        end
467	
468	        -- mouseUp on the X must not fall through to the background pin toggle.
469	        local upOnX = click({ event = "mouseUp", id = "close", recording = false, pinned = false })
470	        check("overlay: mouseUp on X does not toggle pinning",
471	              upOnX and upOnX.env.overlayPinned == false and upOnX.calls.hide == 0,
472	              "overlayPinned = " .. tostring(upOnX and upOnX.env.overlayPinned))
473	
474	        -- Unpinning must not hide the overlay while a recording is still running.
475	        local unpinRec = click({ event = "mouseUp", id = "bg", recording = true, pinned = true })
476	        check("overlay: unpinning mid-recording keeps the overlay on screen",
477	              unpinRec and unpinRec.env.overlayPinned == false and unpinRec.calls.hideOverlay == 0,
478	              "hideOverlay() called " .. tostring(unpinRec and unpinRec.calls.hideOverlay) .. " times while recording")
479	
480	        local unpinIdle = click({ event = "mouseUp", id = "bg", recording = false, pinned = true })
481	        check("overlay: unpinning while idle hides the overlay",
482	              unpinIdle and unpinIdle.env.overlayPinned == false and unpinIdle.calls.hideOverlay == 1,
483	              "hideOverlay() called " .. tostring(unpinIdle and unpinIdle.calls.hideOverlay) .. " times while idle")
484	    end
485	end
486	
487	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
488	-- 12. startRecording re-press recovery (behavioral)
489	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
490	-- Pressing the trigger again inside the 0.3s finalization window must flush the
491	-- pending dictation AND start the new one. Returning after the flush swallowed the
492	-- keypress -- the user held the key and nothing recorded.
493	
494	local function pressTrigger(state)
495	    local env   = baseEnv()
496	    local calls = { final = 0, warmup = 0, overlayText = 0, showOverlay = 0 }
497	    local timerStub = function(tag)
498	        return { stop = function() calls["stopped_" .. tag] = true end }
499	    end
500	
501	    env.log                  = function() end
502	    env.isRecording          = state.recording and true or false
503	    env.isWarmingUp          = state.warmingUp and true or false
504	    env.finalizationPending  = state.pending and true or false
505	    env.warmupAttempt        = 7  -- non-zero, so the reset is observable
506	    env.finalizeTimers       = { timer = timerStub("timer"), watchdog = timerStub("watchdog") }
507	    env.doFinalTranscription = function() calls.final = calls.final + 1 end
508	    env.setOverlayText       = function() calls.overlayText = calls.overlayText + 1 end
509	    env.showOverlay          = function() calls.showOverlay = calls.showOverlay + 1 end
510	    env.tryWarmup            = function() calls.warmup = calls.warmup + 1 end
511	
512	    local fn, err = liftFunction("startRecording", env)
513	    if not fn then return nil, err end
514	    local ok, runErr = pcall(fn)
515	    if not ok then return nil, "startRecording() errored: " .. tostring(runErr) end
516	    return { env = env, calls = calls }
517	end
518	
519	local repress, repressErr = pressTrigger({ pending = true })
520	check("startRecording: function is liftable and compiles", repress ~= nil, tostring(repressErr))
521	
522	if repress then
523	    check("startRecording: a pending finalization is flushed on re-press",
524	          repress.calls.final == 1,
525	          "doFinalTranscription() called " .. repress.calls.final .. " times")
526	    check("startRecording: re-press still starts the new recording (keypress not swallowed)",
527	          repress.calls.warmup == 1 and repress.env.isWarmingUp == true,
528	          "tryWarmup() called " .. repress.calls.warmup .. " times, isWarmingUp = " ..
529	          tostring(repress.env.isWarmingUp))
530	    check("startRecording: the flush cancels both finalization timers",
531	          repress.calls.stopped_timer and repress.calls.stopped_watchdog and
532	          repress.env.finalizeTimers.timer == nil and repress.env.finalizeTimers.watchdog == nil,
533	          "timer stopped=" .. tostring(repress.calls.stopped_timer) ..
534	          " watchdog stopped=" .. tostring(repress.calls.stopped_watchdog) ..
535	          " timer=" .. tostring(repress.env.finalizeTimers.timer) ..
536	          " watchdog=" .. tostring(repress.env.finalizeTimers.watchdog))
537	    check("startRecording: the flush clears finalizationPending",
538	          repress.env.finalizationPending == false,
539	          "finalizationPending = " .. tostring(repress.env.finalizationPending))
540	    check("startRecording: the new recording shows the overlay",
541	          repress.calls.showOverlay == 1 and repress.calls.overlayText == 1,
542	          "showOverlay=" .. repress.calls.showOverlay .. " setOverlayText=" .. repress.calls.overlayText)
543	
544	    local plain = pressTrigger({})
545	    check("startRecording: with nothing pending it just starts recording",
546	          plain and plain.calls.final == 0 and plain.calls.warmup == 1,
547	          "doFinalTranscription=" .. tostring(plain and plain.calls.final) ..
548	          " tryWarmup=" .. tostring(plain and plain.calls.warmup))
549	
550	    local busy = pressTrigger({ recording = true, pending = true })
551	    check("startRecording: no-ops while already recording",
552	          busy and busy.calls.warmup == 0 and busy.calls.final == 0,
553	          "tryWarmup=" .. tostring(busy and busy.calls.warmup) ..
554	          " doFinalTranscription=" .. tostring(busy and busy.calls.final))
555	
556	    local warming = pressTrigger({ warmingUp = true, pending = true })
557	    check("startRecording: no-ops while already warming up",
558	          warming and warming.calls.warmup == 0 and warming.calls.final == 0,
559	          "tryWarmup=" .. tostring(warming and warming.calls.warmup) ..
560	          " doFinalTranscription=" .. tostring(warming and warming.calls.final))
561	end
562	
563	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
564	-- 13. Progress bar reaches 100% (behavioral)
565	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
566	-- Left on the live clock, `elapsed` keeps climbing during transcription and re-trips
567	-- the 90% auto-expand on every finished segment, so barMaxSecs outruns transcribedSecs
568	-- and the blue bar never catches the red one. stopRecordingIndicator() freezes the
569	-- duration into recordedSecs; updateProgressBar() must honour it.
570	
571	local elSrc = src:match("local%s+EL%s*=%s*(%b{})")
572	local EL = elSrc and loadIn("return " .. elSrc, baseEnv(), "EL")
573	EL = EL and EL()
574	check("progress: EL element-index table is extractable", type(EL) == "table",
575	      "could not read `local EL = { ... }` from source")
576	
577	if type(EL) == "table" then
578	    -- Drive updateProgressBar() over a scripted timeline of (clock, transcribedSecs).
579	    local function runBar(steps, recordedSecs)
580	        local env  = baseEnv()
581	        local now  = 0
582	        env.EL     = EL
583	        env.overlay = { [EL.bar_rec] = {}, [EL.bar_txn] = {} }
584	        env.recordingStartTime = 0
585	        env.recordedSecs       = recordedSecs
586	        env.transcribedSecs    = 0
587	        env.barMaxSecs         = 180
588	        env.hs = { timer = { secondsSinceEpoch = function() return now end } }
589	
590	        local fn, err = liftFunction("updateProgressBar", env)
591	        if not fn then return nil, err end
592	        for _, step in ipairs(steps) do
593	            now = step[1]
594	            env.transcribedSecs = step[2]
595	            if step[3] ~= nil then env.recordedSecs = step[3] end
596	            local ok, runErr = pcall(fn)
597	            if not ok then return nil, "updateProgressBar() errored: " .. tostring(runErr) end
598	        end
599	        return {
600	            rec = env.overlay[EL.bar_rec].frame.w,
601	            txn = env.overlay[EL.bar_txn].frame.w,
602	            barMaxSecs = env.barMaxSecs,
603	            env = env,
604	        }
605	    end
606	
607	    -- 100s of audio, then transcription finishes while the wall clock runs on to 240s
608	    -- (past 0.9 * 180 = 162s, which is what used to re-trip the auto-expand).
609	    local bar, barErr = runBar({
610	        { 60,  0 },              -- mid-recording
611	        { 100, 0 },              -- key released at 100s
612	        { 130, 33,  100 },       -- stopRecordingIndicator() froze recordedSecs = 100
613	        { 170, 66 },
614	        { 240, 100 },            -- all 100s transcribed
615	    })
616	    check("progress: updateProgressBar is liftable and compiles", bar ~= nil, tostring(barErr))
617	
618	    if bar then
619	        check("progress: the blue bar reaches the red bar when transcription completes",
620	              bar.txn == bar.rec,
621	              "transcribed bar w=" .. bar.txn .. ", recorded bar w=" .. bar.rec)
622	        check("progress: the bar scale stops expanding once recording stops",
623	              bar.barMaxSecs == 180,
624	              "barMaxSecs grew to " .. bar.barMaxSecs .. " after the recording ended")
625	        check("progress: the bars are drawn at a visible width",
626	              bar.rec == math.floor((100 / 180) * 386),
627	              "recorded bar w=" .. bar.rec .. ", want " .. math.floor((100 / 180) * 386))
628	
629	        -- Half-transcribed audio must still read as half, not as full.
630	        local partial = runBar({ { 100, 0 }, { 300, 50, 100 } })
631	        check("progress: a partially transcribed recording shows a partial blue bar",
632	              partial and partial.txn < partial.rec and partial.txn > 1,
633	              "transcribed w=" .. tostring(partial and partial.txn) ..
634	              ", recorded w=" .. tostring(partial and partial.rec))
635	
636	        -- The freeze must not disable the auto-expand for genuinely long recordings.
637	        local long = runBar({ { 60, 0 }, { 170, 0 } })
638	        check("progress: the bar still auto-expands during a long recording",
639	              long and long.barMaxSecs == 360,
640	              "barMaxSecs = " .. tostring(long and long.barMaxSecs) .. " at 170s recorded (want 360)")
641	    end
642	
643	    -- The two halves of the freeze contract that updateProgressBar depends on.
644	    local startBody = extractFunction("startRecordingIndicator")
645	    local stopBody  = extractFunction("stopRecordingIndicator")
646	    check("progress: startRecordingIndicator clears the frozen duration",
647	          startBody ~= nil and startBody:find("recordedSecs%s*=%s*nil") ~= nil,
648	          "startRecordingIndicator() does not reset recordedSecs = nil")
649	    check("progress: stopRecordingIndicator freezes the recorded duration",
650	          stopBody ~= nil and stopBody:find("recordedSecs%s*=%s*hs%.timer%.secondsSinceEpoch") ~= nil,
651	          "stopRecordingIndicator() does not freeze recordedSecs from the clock")
652	
653	    -- BAR_MAX in updateProgressBar and the bar_bg track width in createOverlay are
654	    -- separate literals; drifting apart would misreport progress at the right edge.
655	    local barMax  = src:match("local%s+BAR_MAX%s*=%s*(%d+)")
656	    local trackW  = src:match('id%s*=%s*"bar_bg".-w%s*=%s*(%d+)')
657	    check("progress: BAR_MAX matches the bar_bg track width",
658	          barMax ~= nil and barMax == trackW,
659	          "BAR_MAX=" .. tostring(barMax) .. ", bar_bg w=" .. tostring(trackW))
660	end
661	
662	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
663	-- Emit results
664	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
665	
666	local out = io.open(OUT, "w")
667	for _, r in ipairs(results) do
668	    out:write((r.passed and "PASS" or "FAIL") .. "\t" .. r.name .. "\t" .. r.detail .. "\n")
669	end
670	out:close()
671

-- Trigger key: "rightAlt", "rightCmd", "rightCtrl"
local TRIGGER_KEY = "rightCmd"

-- User preference files (all in CONFIG_DIR)
local LANG_FILE = CONFIG_DIR .. "/lang"
local OUTPUT_FILE = CONFIG_DIR .. "/output"
local PREFERRED_LANGS_FILE = CONFIG_DIR .. "/preferred_langs"
local ENTER_FILE = CONFIG_DIR .. "/enter"
local PROMPT_FILE = CONFIG_DIR .. "/prompt"
local RECENT_FILE = CONFIG_DIR .. "/recent.json"
local LOG_FILE = WHISPER_TMP .. "/whisper-dictate.log"

-- Action hooks config
local ACTIONS_FILE = HOME .. "/.hammerspoon/local_whisper_actions.lua"

-- Auto-stop on silence
local AUTO_STOP_SILENCE_SECONDS = 3
local AUTO_STOP_THRESHOLD_DB = -40

-- LLM refinement (requires Ollama)
local REFINE_FILE = CONFIG_DIR .. "/refine"
local REFINE_PROMPT_FILE = CONFIG_DIR .. "/refine_prompt"
local REFINE_MODEL_FILE = CONFIG_DIR .. "/refine_model"
local REFINE_DEFAULT_MODEL = "gemma3:4b"
local REFINE_MIN_CHARS = 50  -- skip refinement for short text
local REFINE_DEFAULT_PROMPT = "You are a text cleanup tool. Output ONLY the cleaned text, nothing else. Fix punctuation and capitalization. Remove ONLY filler words like um, uh, you know, I mean. Do NOT remove sentences or meaningful content. When the text lists sequential items using first/second/third or one/two/three, convert them into a numbered list with each item on a new line. NEVER add commentary or preamble. Just output the cleaned text."

local function getRefineModel()
    local f = io.open(REFINE_MODEL_FILE, "r")
    if f then
        local val = f:read("*a"):gsub("%s+", ""); f:close()
        if val ~= "" then return val end
    end
    return REFINE_DEFAULT_MODEL
end

local function getRefinePrompt()
    local f = io.open(REFINE_PROMPT_FILE, "r")
    if f then
        local content = f:read("*a"); f:close()
        content = content:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        if content ~= "" then return content end
    end
    return REFINE_DEFAULT_PROMPT
end

-- Cached so the menu bar doesn't reprobe on every open. Hammerspoon is single-threaded,
-- so a synchronous curl here blocks the eventtap too — hence both --max-time and the cache.
local ollamaProbe = { value = nil, at = 0 }
local OLLAMA_PROBE_TTL = 30  -- seconds

local function hasOllama()
    local now = hs.timer.secondsSinceEpoch()
    if ollamaProbe.value ~= nil and (now - ollamaProbe.at) < OLLAMA_PROBE_TTL then
        return ollamaProbe.value
    end
    -- Check if Ollama API is reachable. --max-time is mandatory: a wedged Ollama (loading a
    -- large model, or a stopped process) would otherwise freeze the whole app, killing the
    -- dictation trigger key until curl gave up on its own.
    local ok = os.execute("curl -s --max-time 1 -o /dev/null -w '' http://localhost:11434/api/tags 2>/dev/null")
    if not ok then
        -- Fallback: check if binary exists
        ok = os.execute("command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1")
    end
    ollamaProbe.value = ok and true or false
    ollamaProbe.at = now
    return ollamaProbe.value
end

local function getRefineMode()
    local f = io.open(REFINE_FILE, "r")
    if not f then return false end
    local val = f:read("*a"):gsub("%s+", ""); f:close()
    return val == "on"
end

local function setRefineMode(on)
    local f = io.open(REFINE_FILE, "w")
    if f then f:write(on and "on" or "off"); f:close() end
end

local function cycleRefine()
    local current = getRefineMode()
    setRefineMode(not current)
end

local RAWFLAGS = hs.eventtap.event.rawFlagMasks

-- Device-specific bits (deviceLeftControl, not the generic control bit), so the left and
-- right halves of the same modifier stay distinguishable — both when the flagsChanged
-- event arrives and when the release poller re-reads the keyboard.
local TRIGGERS = {
    rightAlt   = { mask = RAWFLAGS.deviceRightAlternate, label = "right Option" },
    rightCmd   = { mask = RAWFLAGS.deviceRightCommand,   label = "right Command" },
    rightCtrl  = { mask = RAWFLAGS.deviceRightControl,   label = "right Control" },
    fnLeftCtrl = { mask = RAWFLAGS.secondaryFn | RAWFLAGS.deviceLeftControl, label = "fn + left Control" },
}

local trigger = TRIGGERS[TRIGGER_KEY]
if not trigger then
    hs.notify.new({ title = "local-whisper", informativeText = "ERROR: Invalid TRIGGER_KEY: " .. TRIGGER_KEY }):send()
    return
end

-- Every bit of the mask must be set. A combo trigger (fn + left Control) must not fire on
-- Control alone, which is exactly what a `> 0` test would do — and it would then start a
-- recording on every Ctrl-C the user types.
local function triggerPressed(rawFlags)
    return (rawFlags & trigger.mask) == trigger.mask
end

-- flagsChanged does not fire on key-up for every modifier, so the release is polled by
-- re-reading the live keyboard state through the same mask.
local function triggerHeld()
    local mods = hs.eventtap.checkKeyboardModifiers(true)
    return triggerPressed(mods._raw or 0)
end

local function refineWithOllama(text, callback)
    if not getRefineMode() or not hasOllama() or #text < REFINE_MIN_CHARS then
        callback(text)
        return
    end
    log("refine: sending to Ollama API (" .. #text .. " chars)")
    local prompt = getRefinePrompt() .. "\n\n" .. text
    local model = getRefineModel()
    -- Use Ollama HTTP API (more reliable than CLI, avoids version mismatch issues)
    local jsonPayload = hs.json.encode({
        model = model,
        prompt = prompt,
        stream = false,
    })
    local tmpPayload = WHISPER_TMP .. "/refine_payload.json"
    local f = io.open(tmpPayload, "w")
    if f then f:write(jsonPayload); f:close() end
    local task = hs.task.new("/usr/bin/curl", function(code, stdout, stderr)
        if code == 0 and stdout and #stdout > 0 then
            local ok, result = pcall(hs.json.decode, stdout)
            if ok and result and result.response then
                local refined = result.response:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
                -- Strip common LLM preamble
                refined = refined:gsub("^[Hh]ere%s+is%s+the%s+cleaned%s+text:%s*\n?", "")
                refined = refined:gsub("^[Hh]ere'?s?%s+the%s+cleaned[%-]?%s*text:%s*\n?", "")
                refined = refined:gsub("^[Hh]ere%s+is%s+the%s+refined%s+text:%s*\n?", "")
                refined = refined:gsub("^[Ss]ure[,!]?%s*[Hh]?e?r?e?'?s?%s*t?h?e?%s*", "")
                refined = refined:gsub("^%s+", "")
                if refined ~= "" then
                    log("refine: success (" .. #refined .. " chars)")
                    callback(refined)
                    return
                end
            end
        end
        log("refine: failed (code=" .. tostring(code) .. "), using original")
        callback(text)
    end, {
        "-s", "-X", "POST",
        "http://localhost:11434/api/generate",
        "-H", "Content-Type: application/json",
        "-d", "@" .. tmpPayload,
    })
    task:setEnvironment({ HOME = HOME, PATH = "/usr/bin:/bin" })
    task:start()
end

local function insertTranscribedText(text, detectedLang)
    if text == "" or isHallucination(text) then
        hideOverlay()
        return
    end

    -- Apply app-aware post-processing
    text = postProcess(text, capturedAppBundleID)
    if text == "" then hideOverlay(); return end

    finishInsertion(text, detectedLang)
end
input.old_string:
-- Insert transcribed text at cursor, with post-processing, optional LLM refinement, and action hooks
local function insertTranscribedText(text, detectedLang)
    if text == "" or isHallucination(text) then
        hideOverlay()
        return
    end

    -- Apply app-aware post-processing
    text = postProcess(text, capturedAppBundleID)
    if text == "" then hideOverlay(); return end

    -- Skip LLM refinement for voice commands (refine would strip the prefix)
    local isVoiceCommand = text:lower():match("voice%s+command")

    -- Optional LLM refinement (async, skips short text and voice commands)
    if not isVoiceCommand and getRefineMode() and #text >= REFINE_MIN_CHARS then
        setOverlayText("Refining...")
        refineWithOllama(text, function(refined)
            finishInsertion(refined, detectedLang)
        end)
    else
        finishInsertion(text, detectedLang)
    end
end

                end
            end)

            if releasePoller then releasePoller:stop(); releasePoller = nil end

local GENERIC_MOD = { rightAlt = "alt", rightCmd = "cmd", rightCtrl = "ctrl" }
local genericMod = GENERIC_MOD[TRIGGER_KEY]

local releasePoller = nil

-- Global so we can inspect state via hs -c
_whisper = { modTap = nil, recording = false }

local modTap = hs.eventtap.new({ hs.eventtap.event.types.flagsChanged }, function(event)
    -- Wrap in pcall so errors don't kill the eventtap
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        local rawFlags = event:rawFlags()
        local triggered = (rawFlags & triggerMask) > 0

        if triggered and not isRecording then
            startRecording()
            -- Poll for release since flagsChanged doesn't fire on key-up
            if releasePoller then releasePoller:stop() end
            releasePoller = hs.timer.doEvery(0.1, function()
                local mods = hs.eventtap.checkKeyboardModifiers()
                if not mods[genericMod] then
                    releasePoller:stop()
                    releasePoller = nil
                    stopRecording()
                end
            end)
        elseif not triggered and (isRecording or isWarmingUp) then
            if releasePoller then releasePoller:stop(); releasePoller = nil end
            stopRecording()
        end
    end)
    if not ok then log("eventtap error: " .. tostring(err)) end

    return false
end)
modTap:start()
_whisper.modTap = modTap

tool.name: Edit

input.new_string:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 14. Trigger matching (behavioral -- runs the real triggerPressed/triggerHeld)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The trigger is a modifier COMBO (fn + left Control), which opens two failure modes
-- a single-modifier trigger never had:
--   * `rawFlags & mask > 0` fires on half the combo -- plain Control would start a
--     recording, i.e. every Ctrl-C in a terminal
--   * polling the release through generic modifier names ("ctrl") cannot tell left
--     Control from right Control, so the poller both over- and under-fires
-- Both are exercised against the trigger actually configured in the source.

local RAWFLAGS     = hs.eventtap.event.rawFlagMasks
local triggerKey   = src:match('local%s+TRIGGER_KEY%s*=%s*"([%w_]+)"')
local triggersSrc  = src:match("local%s+TRIGGERS%s*=%s*(%b{})")
check("trigger: TRIGGER_KEY and the TRIGGERS table are extractable",
      triggerKey ~= nil and triggersSrc ~= nil,
      "TRIGGER_KEY=" .. tostring(triggerKey) .. ", TRIGGERS table found=" .. tostring(triggersSrc ~= nil))

if triggerKey and triggersSrc then
    local tEnv = baseEnv()
    tEnv.RAWFLAGS = RAWFLAGS
    local tFactory, tErr = loadIn("return " .. triggersSrc, tEnv, "TRIGGERS")
    local TRIGGERS = tFactory and tFactory()
    local trig = type(TRIGGERS) == "table" and TRIGGERS[triggerKey] or nil

    check("trigger: TRIGGER_KEY names a defined trigger with a mask and a label",
          type(trig) == "table" and type(trig.mask) == "number" and type(trig.label) == "string",
          "TRIGGERS[" .. triggerKey .. "] = " .. tostring(trig) .. " " .. tostring(tErr))

    if trig and type(trig.mask) == "number" then
        -- Pin today's choice: hold fn + left Control to dictate.
        check("trigger: the configured trigger is fn + left Control",
              trig.mask == (RAWFLAGS.secondaryFn | RAWFLAGS.deviceLeftControl),
              string.format("mask=0x%x, want 0x%x (fn|deviceLeftControl)",
                            trig.mask, RAWFLAGS.secondaryFn | RAWFLAGS.deviceLeftControl))

        local env = baseEnv()
        env.trigger = trig
        local pressed, pErr = liftFunction("triggerPressed", env)
        check("trigger: triggerPressed is liftable and compiles", pressed ~= nil, tostring(pErr))

        if pressed then
            check("trigger: the full combo fires", pressed(trig.mask) == true,
                  string.format("triggerPressed(0x%x) = false", trig.mask))
            check("trigger: no modifiers at all does not fire", pressed(0) == false,
                  "triggerPressed(0) = true")

            -- Every individual bit of a combo mask must be insufficient on its own.
            -- This is the `> 0` regression, expressed without hardcoding which combo.
            local partials = {}
            local bit = 1
            local bitCount = 0
            while bit <= trig.mask do
                if (trig.mask & bit) ~= 0 then
                    bitCount = bitCount + 1
                    if bit ~= trig.mask and pressed(bit) then
                        partials[#partials + 1] = string.format("0x%x", bit)
                    end
                end
                bit = bit << 1
            end
            check("trigger: no single half of the combo fires on its own",
                  #partials == 0,
                  "these partial flag sets fired: " .. table.concat(partials, ", "))
            check("trigger: the trigger is an actual combo (more than one modifier bit)",
                  bitCount > 1, "mask has " .. bitCount .. " bit(s)")

            -- Real events carry the generic bits too (control alongside deviceLeftControl),
            -- plus whatever else the user happens to be holding.
            local noise = RAWFLAGS.control | RAWFLAGS.shift | RAWFLAGS.deviceLeftShift | RAWFLAGS.nonCoalesced
            check("trigger: unrelated modifiers held at the same time do not block it",
                  pressed(trig.mask | noise) == true,
                  string.format("triggerPressed(0x%x) = false", trig.mask | noise))

            -- The mirror-image modifier must stay inert: right Control is not left Control.
            local mirrored = (trig.mask & ~RAWFLAGS.deviceLeftControl) | RAWFLAGS.deviceRightControl | RAWFLAGS.control
            check("trigger: the right-hand twin of the modifier does not fire",
                  pressed(mirrored) == false,
                  string.format("triggerPressed(0x%x) = true — right Control matched a left-Control trigger", mirrored))
        end

        -- triggerHeld() drives the release poller. It must read the raw device flags
        -- through the same mask, not a generic modifier name.
        local held, hErr = liftFunction("triggerHeld", baseEnv())
        check("trigger: triggerHeld is liftable and compiles", held ~= nil, tostring(hErr))
        if held and pressed then
            local liveFlags, rawArg = 0, nil
            local hEnv = baseEnv()
            hEnv.trigger        = trig
            hEnv.triggerPressed = pressed
            hEnv.hs = { eventtap = { checkKeyboardModifiers = function(raw)
                rawArg = raw
                return { _raw = liveFlags }
            end } }
            held = liftFunction("triggerHeld", hEnv)

            liveFlags = trig.mask
            check("trigger: triggerHeld is true while the whole combo is down",
                  held() == true, "held() = false with the full mask down")
            check("trigger: triggerHeld asks for raw device flags",
                  rawArg == true,
                  "checkKeyboardModifiers() called with " .. tostring(rawArg) ..
                  " — without raw flags it cannot tell left from right")

            -- Releasing either half must end the recording.
            local released = {}
            local bit = 1
            while bit <= trig.mask do
                if (trig.mask & bit) ~= 0 and bit ~= trig.mask then
                    liveFlags = trig.mask & ~bit
                    if held() then released[#released + 1] = string.format("0x%x", bit) end
                end
                bit = bit << 1
            end
            check("trigger: releasing either modifier reads as released",
                  #released == 0,
                  "still held after releasing: " .. table.concat(released, ", "))

            liveFlags = 0
            check("trigger: nothing held reads as released", held() == false, "held() = true with no modifiers")
        end
    end

    -- Wiring: both paths must go through the helpers above rather than re-deriving
    -- the match inline, which is how the two failure modes got in last time.
    check("trigger: the eventtap matches through triggerPressed(event:rawFlags())",
          src:find("triggerPressed%s*%(%s*event:rawFlags%s*%(%s*%)%s*%)") ~= nil,
          "the flagsChanged handler does not call triggerPressed(event:rawFlags())")

    local pollSrc = src:match("releasePoller%s*=%s*hs%.timer%.doEvery%s*(%b())")
    check("trigger: the release poller re-checks the trigger through triggerHeld()",
          pollSrc ~= nil and pollSrc:find("triggerHeld") ~= nil,
          "release poller body: " .. tostring(pollSrc and pollSrc:sub(1, 120)))
end
